Name: Better Quarry Redux
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
This mod makes the quarry more viable and profitable by spawning a set number of geodes, ores, and gems every day in the Quarry.

—Mod Prerequisites—
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI
[/url]- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]

—Installation—
Place the content pack [FTM] Better Quarry Redux in /Mods

—Credits—
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56561342]EscaMMC[/url] for the FTM framework and super quick responses to my million questions.
This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/771/][b]Better Quarry[/b][/url] by Nishtra. Unfortunately the mod hasn't been updated in a while and seems to be abandoned.
